name: Madagascar
summary_text: Madagascar demands real caution from trans visitors. Same-sex conduct is legal — unusual for the region — but France 24 documents that LGBT people must hide to keep jobs and live in peace; there is no LGR, no anti-discrimination law, and no visible community outside Antananarivo. No documented police targeting pattern.

sources.claim_summary: France 24 'Focus' report (Aug 2024): 'LGBT people in Madagascar forced to hide their sexuality' — although homosexuality is not illegal, it is widely considered socially unacceptable; many hide to keep jobs and live in peace, developing their own networks and coded language.

US State Department 2011 Human Rights Report for Madagascar: documents the post-coup regime, unlawful killings, and 'societal discrimination and violence against women, persons with disabilities, and the lesbian, gay, bisexual and transgender (LGBT) community'.

sources.claim_summary: BBC News Pidgin (July 2020): 'Homosexuality decriminalization and LGBT Rights in Africa' - overview of African nations that have decriminalised (Gabon joining ~22 of 53), with penalties of 10+ years elsewhere; regional context for Madagascar.

sources.title: LGBT Rights In Madagascar: Everything You Should Know Before You Visit! 🇲🇬
sources.claim_summary: Queer In The World: 'LGBT Rights In Madagascar: Everything You Should Know Before You Visit' - country guide covering the legal situation (legal but unequal age of consent) and travel considerations.

sources.title: Madagascar: a setback for LGBT+ rights in the Indian Ocean
sources.claim_summary: Erasing 76 Crimes (July 2025): Madagascar rejected UN UPR recommendations to combat anti-LGBT violence and hate speech and to equalise the age of consent; six organisations (Queer Place, Mifoha Olo Mazoto, Divers' Unité, Justice Égalitaire, Men Engage, Madagascar LGBT+) protested: 'Refusing to act is to endorse impunity and condone violence.'

sources.title: Madagascar LGBTQI+ Resources – Rights in Exile
sources.claim_summary: Rights in Exile (AsyLex) Madagascar LGBTQI+ resources: legal framework - homosexual activity legal but Article 331 sets a different age of consent for same-sex acts; public attitudes, state protection capacity, case law, supporting organisations and country-of-origin experts.
